title: piranhea mexicana
intro: Piranhea mexicana, commonly known as the Mexican Piranhea or Piranhea tree, is a plant species belonging to the family Rhizophoraceae. It is a medicinal plant traditionally used in folk medicine to treat various health conditions, including fever, rheumatism, and skin disorders. Piranhea mexicana is valued for its therapeutic actions, including anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, which contribute to its health benefits such as reducing pain and inflammation, and promoting wound healing. The plant's bioactive constituents include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic compounds, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions and medicinal properties.
